description: Public profile facts for a space company: what it does, sector, country, headquarters, founding year, public or private, ticker, funding and last round as shown on its profile (for a listed company the funding figure is the private rounds it raised before listing, and fundingBasis says which rule applies), and its Space Score when it is ranked.

limit.description: How many matching companies to return (1 to 5).

query.description: Company name, profile slug or stock ticker, e.g. "Rocket Lab", "rocket-lab" or "RKLB".

name: company_lookup
title: Company lookup
